actions.expr: IIF(CONTAINS(model,'$[RAPI]'),NUMBER(insulationArea)*IIF((NUMBER(frameDepth)==25),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Knauf Earthwool Thermal Insulation - ALUGLASS Facing - Ecose - 48Kg/m3 x 25mm x 1.2m x 10m (12 sqm/ROLL)]','cost')),IIF((NUMBER(frameDepth)==50),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Knauf Earthwool Thermal Insulation - ALUGLASS Facing - Ecose - 48Kg/m3 x 50mm x 1.2m x 10m (12 sqm/ROLL)]','cost')),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Knauf Earthwool Thermal Insulation - ALUGLASS Facing - Ecose - 48Kg/m3 x 25mm x 1.2m x 10m (12 sqm/ROLL)]','cost'))+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Knauf Earthwool Thermal Insulation - ALUGLASS Facing - Ecose - 48Kg/m3 x 50mm x 1.2m x 10m (12 sqm/ROLL)]','cost'))))*(1+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[FRAD Accessories Wastage]','cost'))),0)

NUMBER(boltSetQty)*IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[SS304L]','$[SS316L]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Bolt Hex SS304 6mmx25mm]','cost'))+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Wing Nut SS 6mm]','cost'))+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Washer Straight SS 6mm]','cost')),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Bolt GI 6mmx25mm]','cost'))+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Wing Head Nut GI 6mm]','cost'))+CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Washer Straight GI 6mm]','cost')))

EVALUATE(' return Math.max(input.arg1,input.arg2);', CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Min Door Fabrication Minutes]','cost')), NUMBER(doorTopCoverArea)*IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[GI]','$[MS]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & MS Door Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost')),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Door Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost'))))

CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Fixed Frame Fabrication Minutes]','cost'))+NUMBER(frameArea)*IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[GI]','$[MS]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & MS Frame Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost')),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Frame Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost')))

IIF(CONTAINS(roundTransition,'$[Yes]'),EVALUATE(' return Math.max(input.arg1,input.arg2);', 10, NUMBER(transitionArea)*IIF(CONTAINS(material,'$[GI]','$[MS]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[GI & MS Fitting Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost')),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[SS Fitting Fabrication Minutes (per sqm)]','cost')))),0)

(NUMBER(frameArea)*2+NUMBER(doorInsulationCoverArea)+NUMBER(doorTopCoverArea)*2)*IIF(CONTAINS(finish,'$[Red Oxide Paint]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Red Oxide Paint Cost per SQM]','cost')),IIF(CONTAINS(finish,'$[Galvanic Paint]'),CFLOAT(OBJECTATTRIBUTEV(countryWiseCost,'$[Galvanic Paint Cost per SQM]','cost')),0))
